QuestInfo.name: Finding the Instructor
QuestInfo.0: It seems like #b#p221##k in #b#m10001000##k wants to test whether I'm worthy of receiving her teachings.
QuestInfo.1: #m10001000#'s #b#p221# gave me a letter to deliver it to the #b#p227##k, who I should be able to find somewhere on #b#m10001090##k. She said I'd learn the rest of the details there.
QuestInfo.2: On #b#m10001090##k, I met the #b#p227##k. She said she would test whether I was worthy of making the 2nd job advancement. Great! I told her I was ready for anything!

0.0: Well, what do you think? Don't you want to get even more powerful? Pass a simple test and I'll help you do just that. Do you want to do it?

yes.0: Good decision. You look strong, but I need to see if you really are strong enough to pass the test. It's not a difficult test, so you'll do just fine. Here, take my letter first... Make sure you don't lose it!
yes.1: Please get this letter to the #b#p227##k who should be around #b#m10001090##k near #m10001000#. She's acting as the job instructor in my place.
yes.2: Give her the letter and she'll test you in my stead. Best of luck to you.

no.0: Really? Have to give it more thought, huh? Take your time, take your time. This is not something you should take lightly... Come talk to me once you have made your decision.

1.0: Hmmm... It is definitely the letter from #b#p221##k... So, you came all the way here to take the test and make the 2nd job advancement as a Bowman?
